items.title: phpAfterShell Explained: How Hackers Could Turn a PHP Session Flaw Into Code Execution
items.description: PHP's default file-based session storage can be made to return objects an attacker chose, by cutting off a session write at the right moment. When combined with a second weakness, such as a suitable gadget chain in the app, those objects can allow the attacker to run code on the server.
